, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly “normalized” the universally attested death date of Alexander the Great from June 323 BCE to 322 BCE by misapplying astronomical year numbering and 323/322 civic-year notation, contradicting all cited sources (Britannica, History.com, World History Encyclopedia) that place his death in 323 BCE.
